title.cn: 八达岭：好汉与小腿谈判

text.cn: 大巴摇晃得像在做核心训练。台阶无穷，人群更无穷。有人塞名片：『外模？拍户外大片，日结。』风很大，名片差点飞去蒙古。
text.en: The bus shakes like core training. Stairs endless; crowds more endless. A card is pressed into your hand: “Foreign model? Outdoor shoot, paid today.” Wind almost mails it to Mongolia.

text.cn: 徒步登城：用腿兑换「不到长城非好汉」。
text.en: Hike the wall: pay calves for hero status.

feedback.cn: 你成为好汉的同时，也成为了防晒与瓶装水的奴隶。远处烽火台在笑。
feedback.en: You become a hero and a slave to sunscreen and bottled water. A distant watchtower seems amused.

text.cn: 坐缆车：保留膝盖，保留尊严的一部分。
text.en: Cable car: keep knees, keep partial dignity.

feedback.cn: 贵，但腿还在。有人在缆车上拍 vlog，你在心里拍「省力纪录片」。
feedback.en: Pricey, but legs intact. Someone shoots a vlog; you shoot a mental “energy conservation doc”.

text.cn: 💰 接模特单：在墙垛上吹风摆姿势两小时。
text.en: 💰 Model gig: pose in the wind for two hours.

lockedHint.cn: 约拍门槛：Sanity ≥ 70 且电量 ≥ 25。没电的模特只是一块会走路的背景板。
lockedHint.en: Gig gate: Sanity ≥ 70 and Battery ≥ 25. A dead-phone model is just a walking backdrop.

feedback.cn: 日结到账。笑容僵住。你开始理解「外模」有时只是会走路的滤镜。
feedback.en: Paid. Smile frozen. You learn “foreign model” sometimes means a walking filter.

text.cn: 长城日结束。小腿在抗议，风景不退款。
text.en: Wall day ends. Calves protest; scenery offers no refunds.
